target_provenance: New synthetic analytic yardstick from upright stem/rise, level baseline/x-height and continuous rounded turn requirements. Vertical line segments and radius-0.2 semicircles; no candidate controls, sampled candidate paths, rendered pixels or builder functions are inputs. Round-number width 0.4 and origin -0.2 are declared construction conventions, not a fit or an owner-approved target. Failure against this stylized yardstick is not an owner appearance rejection. Never revise it after scoring.
angle_clearance_policy: Report-only diagnostics. No new angle, counter-area, retracing darkness or blank-clearance acceptance threshold is owner-approved. Preserve this limitation even if numerical gates pass.
seed_policy: Frozen deterministic candidate with no stochastic controller/session effects. Seeds are independent fresh-process replay identities, not three trained candidates or statistical robustness evidence.
reversal_scope: Continuous stem-to-overturn n, underturn-to-stem u and repeated overturn m include explicit pen-down reversal events; placed-mu tests fixed placement and interletter air, not context learning.
subdivision_scope: Exact De Casteljau halves inside each existing primitive, two cubics instead of one. No additional references, primitives or gesture instances; all unchanged schema caps must validate, including six expanded references for m. Whole-letter subdivision is claimed only through this cap-preserving representation.
overlap_measurement: Per-gesture actual swept physical-nib occupancy at 180 DPI. Intersection and union pixels record repeated coverage independently of centerline crossings. Require attribution to declared contributor pairs. Boundary segments belong to both adjacent gestures. Darkness/ink-depletion effects are not simulated or accepted.
scope: Frozen synthetic fixed-tool actual-contact evaluation, not historical-hand, S2, context or fatigue admission. Original nominal approval is preserved. Renewed actual-ink review remains separate and pending. Targets and limits remain unchanged regardless of failure.
